final: WITH regional_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), totals AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_count FROM regional_counts), shares AS (SELECT r.client_count, 1.0 * r.client_count / t.total_count AS share FROM regional_counts AS r JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares), above_average AS (SELECT s.client_count, s.share, s.share - a.value AS difference FROM shares AS s JOIN average_share AS a ON a.value IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.value) SELECT SUM(client_count), AVG(share), AVG(difference) FROM above_average
